notes.title: REVOLUTION UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello footballers! ⚽️

We're thrilled to announce that the REVOLUTION UPDATE for SFF has just been released.
The team worked really hard to meet your expectations making the game more realistic.

Here are the most important and outstanding changes:


New more realistic character proportions.
Human goalkeepers implemented.
Third Person Perspective camera for character control mode and camera options.
New kicking mechanisms: jump and kick, quick shot. All to make the gameplay more fluid.
Normal (not sliding) tackle implemented.
Adjusted speed, acceleration, and agility parameters making movement more realistic.
Mechanism for more realistic ball receiving implemented. It will take more time to control the ball for weaker footballers.
Adjusted all player attributes to better differentiate weaker footballers from better ones.
Through pass now will be always aimed toward the line between the receiver and opponent's gate.
While performing sliding tackle the character now tries to reach the ball better.
Character now jumps toward the predicted ball location.
Graphics performance hugely improved.
More realistic lighting.
...and more minor gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

Side note - Chinese and Arabic languages are temporarily switched off until we fix them. Sorry for this. Those languages will be restored soon.

notes.title: Serious Fun Football Patch Notes version 0.95
notes.notes:
Serious Fun Football version 0.95
IMPROVEMENTS
- Improvement. Goalkeeper catches the ball in "hands".
- Improvement. Situational kicking implemented. If footballer has no time to adjust the body to perform high precision shoot/pass, he perform quick situational kick instead.
- Improvement. Decreased Ball size. Ups I did it again...
- Improvement. Character performs passes faster.
- Improvement. Ball landing place marker appears not only after high pass but also when the free ball is in high altitude.
- Improvement. Reworked netcode which improves ping.
- Improvement. Online matches in Solo Mode will start with just two players in session. Players will be able to join during the match. In future it may change.
FIXES
- Fix. Character brakes faster.
- Fix. While performing sliding tackle the body is slightly being adjusted towards the ball.

notes.title: Serious Fun Football Patch Notes version 0.93
notes.notes:
Serious Fun Football version 0.93
IMPROVEMENTS

 Improvement. Texture optimization
 Improvement. Body collision has been reworked and Strength attribute has been added. 
Examples: stronger player can slightly push weaker player from behind or will be "glued" to him if he is not stronger; if you release direction controls after you bumped into the fence then you're character will stop.
 Improvement. Pass accuracy implemented
 Improvement. Decreased Ball size
 Improvement. Kicking from the first ball after receiving high ball implemented (character position auto adjustment while holding kick button and pointing kick target).

notes.title: Serious Fun Football Patch Notes version 0.925
notes.notes:
Serious Fun Football version 0.925
IMPROVEMENTS

 Improvement. Added assist in receiving the ball pass in Fun Mode.
 Improvement. Added semi-assist in receiving the ball pass in Serious/Team Mode.
 Improvement. Passing using low through pass now tries to avoid opponents if they stand in the way.
 Improvement. Kick is not cancelled immediately after bumping into other character.
 Improvement. Turning around while kicking is now faster.
 Improvement. Low pass played tries to avoid opponent standing in the way.
 Improvement. Optimized through pass plays near the fence.
FIXES
 Fix. AI now jumps when the high ball targeted on the head is played.
 Fix. The language is no longer changed to polish after restarting the game.
 Fix. The X and B buttons are no longer mismatched in the Options Menu.
 Fix. AI doesn't change unexpectedly direction while pass is played towards them.
 Fix. Targeting pass to specific teammate doesn't result in not intuitive mistakes.
 Fix. Controls configuration doesn't change to default after restarting the game.

notes.title: SFF develoopment update
notes.notes:
⚽️ Dear SFF followers! ⚽️

The game's development is advanced and still progressing, we're getting closer and closer to the finish. 😉 However recently, after our internal tests, we've decided to add many more new features to the gameplay so the game is more fluid and dynamic. 😱
Also currently we are analyzing the possibility of cooperation with publishing and marketing companies. To be honest, untill now, we didn't even think about marketing... there was no time for this (so much IT work...)! But it's time to change this small indie project into something... serious, right? 🤔

All this results in postponing release date few months. 🙁 We aim to be ready at the beginning of 2022! 😁

In the meantime we plan to send an early version of the Demo to some Influencers and shortly after this give you a free Demo. 😱 And this will happen really soon!

Thank you very much for being with us at such an early stage of the game's life. You are really special!

⚽️ See you soon. ⚽️
